title: Planetary gearbox
about: a 4:1 planetary gearbox with an 18-tooth sun, three planets and a 54-tooth ring, its tooth counts checked before anything is built
tries: Make it 5:1 and keep three planets | Use four planets and find tooth counts that fit | Give the carrier a Ø8 mm output shaft with a flat for a set screw

agent.role: a transmission designer who sizes planetary sets from tooth counts
agent.prompt: Prefer changing zs, zp and n and let the script derive the ring and the centre distance; check every mesh with j.inspect.gearMesh; never place a planet where (zs + zr) / n is not whole.

fragments.counts: State z_ring = z_sun + 2 z_planet, (z_sun + z_ring) / n and the ratio 1 + z_ring / z_sun for every change.
